concept: Idle bucket expiry and archived bucket reopening
summary: Source-anchored research for Idle bucket expiry and archived bucket reopening. Run status: COMPLETED.

facts.text: An idle bucket is an open bucket without pending uncommitted measurements. In the implementation, marking a bucket idle requires allCommitted(bucket). (medium confidence) Sources: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo/master/src/mongo/db/timeseries/README.md ; https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo/master/src/mongo/db/timeseries/bucket_catalog/bucket_catalog_internal.cpp

When loadBucketIntoCatalog finds the archived entry for the reopened bucket, it erases that entry before transferring the reopened bucket into openBucketsById. The archived key contains collection UUID, metadata hash, and minTime. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30)

An idle bucket is open and has no pending uncommitted measurements. Catalog memory above timeseriesIdleBucketExpiryMemoryUsageThreshold triggers expiry; idleness does not require an elapsed inactivity timeout. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30)

Expiry increments numBucketsArchivedDueToMemoryThreshold when it archives an eligible idle bucket, and numBucketsClosedDueToMemoryThreshold when it closes one or removes an archived entry. These counters represent different actions. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30)

Alibaba Cloud's MongoDB 8.0 parameter table identifies timeseriesIdleBucketExpiryMemoryUsageThreshold as the idle-bucket memory trigger. This independently corroborates the memory-triggered semantics documented by MongoDB. (high confidence)

The same migration account reports that its runtime threshold reverted after container restart because startup configuration did not preserve it. The author added a mongod --setParameter startup argument to retain the chosen value. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-31)

The inspected expiry path increments numBucketsArchivedDueToMemoryThreshold for its eligible-idle archival branch, while closing archived entries increments numBucketsClosedDueToMemoryThreshold. Read the counters separately when diagnosing memory-driven bucket churn. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30)

SERVER-94559 documents a historical failure in which deletion changed an archived bucket's minTime. Reopening then failed to remove its archived entry; concurrent memory-pressure expiry could remove its registered state and cause a later write invariant failure. The issue lists fixes in 7.0.16 and 8.0.4. (low confidence) (verified as of 2025-01-29)

timeseriesIdleBucketExpiryMemoryUsageThreshold controls pressure-driven expiry of idle bucket state; expireIdleBuckets checks catalog memory usage against its threshold, rather than comparing wall-clock inactivity to an idle timeout. (medium confidence) Sources: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo/master/src/mongo/db/timeseries/README.md ; https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo/master/src/mongo/db/timeseries/bucket_catalog/bucket_catalog_internal.cpp

Archiving removes most in-memory bucket state but retains a small record. An archived bucket still resides on disk, and accepting another measurement requires loading it and reconstructing in-memory state. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30)

If memory pressure persists, expiry can erase archived records. This catalog removal does not permanently disable the persisted bucket; query-based reopening can remain possible. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30)

The implementation adds newly idle buckets at the front of a stripe's idle list and expires from its back. Expiry work checks a per-attempt counter and the memory threshold, so one attempt need not bring usage below the threshold. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30)

Archived reopening checks collection UUID, metadata-key hash and a compatible time range before returning a candidate ObjectId. The caller checks for conflicting operations before retrieving the bucket; a candidate is not a guaranteed successful reopening. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30) Sources: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo/master/src/mongo/db/timeseries/bucket_catalog/bucket_catalog_internal.cpp ; https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo/master/src/mongo/db/timeseries/bucket_catalog/bucket_catalog.cpp

Sangki Han's July 16, 2026 migration account, using MongoDB 6.0, reports 3,459,670 memory-threshold closures and near one-measurement-per-bucket fragmentation. Raising the threshold to 512 MiB and resetting the collection reportedly yielded 17,000 buckets for 17,000 sites. This is one workload observation, not a general sizing recommendation. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-31)

Historical SERVER-61309 links bucket pointer reuse during reacquisition to deadlocks, inconsistent state and crashes, with _expireIdleBuckets among possible stack frames. The issue lists fixes in 5.0.5, 5.1.1 and 5.2.0; it does not establish that current releases retain that defect. (low confidence)
Archival removes most in-memory bucket state but retains a compact record. If memory pressure persists, expiry can discard archived records as well. (medium confidence)

In the inspected expireIdleBuckets implementation, cleanup acts on the current stripe, takes idle buckets from the back of its idle list, and shares a bounded attempt counter across idle and archived cleanup loops. It does not guarantee that one attempt brings total catalog memory below the threshold. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30)

Archived reopening can use a retained bucket OID to fetch the stored bucket and reconstruct its in-memory representation. The inspected candidate lookup matches collection UUID and metadata hash and requires the measurement timestamp to fit the bucket time span. (medium confidence) Sources: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo/master/src/mongo/db/timeseries/README.md ; https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo/master/src/mongo/db/timeseries/bucket_catalog/bucket_catalog_internal.cpp

Catalog eviction leaves stored bucket data intact; retention expiry through expireAfterSeconds deletes bucket data. A bucket removed under catalog pressure can remain eligible for query-based reopening. (medium confidence)

In a July 16, 2026 MongoDB 6.0.x deployment report covering 17,000 sites, Sangki Han observed 3,459,670 memory-threshold closures and approximately one measurement per commit. After increasing the threshold to 512 MiB and resetting the collection, the author observed 17,000 buckets. This is one workload observation, not a general sizing recommendation. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-31)

The same operator reports that the runtime threshold setting disappeared after container restarts; supplying --setParameter in the container startup command preserved it. The report also describes a suspected host-memory exhaustion incident after increasing the threshold and ingestion load. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-31)
